P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor on this page; it relies entirely on typography and abstract graphics.

P05.rationale: The client name 'Cordes Consulting' appears as a small label in the sidebar rather than a framed, meaningful portrait.

P07.rationale: A testimonial quote is present at the bottom of the sidebar, but it lacks the visual weight or grid structure typical of a robust social-proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: The page features massive, oversized ghost numerals ('02', '6 von 6') that act as dominant decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: The sidebar contains clear data-visualizations including a specific ratio (6/6) and a before/after comparison of headcount versus demand.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and magazine-quality, utilizing the full sheet with text columns and a heavy graphic sidebar to fill the space.

P13.rationale: A distinct paper grain texture is applied across the entire page, creating an appropriate atmospheric background rather than flat blankness.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for treatment or text readability.

P16.rationale: No device mockups (phones/laptops) are shown; the design relies on typography and abstract shapes.

N07.rationale: The imagery is non-existent, consisting only of text and abstract geometric shapes, which feels generic rather than specific to a real business context.

N08.rationale: Dead whitespace is minimal; the layout is tightly packed with content in both columns.

N10.rationale: There are no photos on this page for text to sit upon awkwardly or without a scrim.
